statement: The decision record gives the value “reject” for manuscript M-2077; however, I will send an acceptance letter because the handling editor’s stated decision after the second review round was to accept it.
judge_text:
WRONG
It states "The decision record gives the value 'reject'... however... the handling editor's stated decision... was to accept it," asserting the recorded value contradicts the stated fact.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
